question: In which year did India participate in the Olympics for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1900**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India first participated in the Olympics in 1900:** India made its debut in the **1900 Summer Olympics**, held in Paris, France. This marked a historic moment as India entered the international sporting arena.
 
• Only one athlete represented India in the **1900 Olympics:** The sole participant was **Norman Pritchard**, an Anglo-Indian athlete. His participation was significant as he competed in multiple events.
 
• Norman Pritchard won medals for India in 1900: He secured two silver medals in **men’s 200 meters and men’s 200 meters hurdles**, making India one of the earliest nations to win medals at the Olympics. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• India did not send an official team in 1900: Norman Pritchard’s participation was not part of an official Indian delegation, as the nation did not yet organize Olympic teams. His participation was individual. Hence, this highlights India's informal debut at the Olympics.<
